research_question: Holding the E1 Combined vectorizer (word 1-2 gram + char 3-5 gram TF-IDF vocabulary and IDF), the feature configuration and C=1 fixed, does appending controlled typo-perturbed copies of D1 Train to the training set make the detector more robust to misspelled prompts, and what does it cost on clean text and on benign-only false alarms?
threat_model: accidental single-character typos in alphabetic words of at least four letters (adjacent swap, deletion, duplication, QWERTY-neighbour substitution; interior letters only)

frozen.note: The fitted FeatureUnion is taken from the E1 joblib (hash cross-checked against results/e1/selected_models.csv) and is never refit, cloned or passed to GridSearchCV. Only the Logistic Regression is retrained, once per training-set composition. Vocabulary, IDF and coefficient content hashes are recorded.

seeds.note: Single source of truth for every seed. Training, selection and evaluation perturbation seeds are disjoint; the classifier seed must equal configs/e1.json seed and must not change.

typo.pre_freeze_forbidden: normalized hashes of D1 Train and D1 Validation originals plus already generated texts of the same condition
typo.post_freeze_audit: every augmented and perturbed text is compared with all six processed splits; counts go to results/e5/duplicate_equivalence_check.json; nothing is altered

lexicon.source: D1 Train labels only, eligible-shaped lower-cased unigrams
lexicon.k_rule: the smallest candidate k whose top-k attack words occur in at least coverage_target of the eligible attack texts of D1 Train AND whose top-k benign words occur in at least coverage_target of the eligible benign texts; otherwise the largest candidate (recorded as target not met). k is capped at half the number of candidate words so the two class lists never overlap. A training-only statistic, fixed before any model is scored.
lexicon.policy: attack texts receive the typo in the present attack-indicative word with the largest |log-odds| (first occurrence); benign texts in the benign-indicative word; random1 fallback is recorded

conditions.name: dup_x1
conditions.description: count-matched control: originals + one exact duplicate of every eligible text (same parent set as aug_random1_x1); never eligible as primary

conditions.name: aug_random1_x1
conditions.description: originals + one copy per eligible text with exactly one typo in a uniformly random eligible word

conditions.name: aug_random_p30_x1
conditions.description: originals + one copy with typos in ceil(0.30 x eligible words) distinct words, at least one

conditions.name: aug_targeted1_x1
conditions.description: originals + one copy with one typo in the lexicon word of the text's own class (attack texts: attack-indicative word; benign texts: benign-indicative word)

conditions.name: aug_random1_x2
conditions.description: originals + two independently seeded random1 copies; copy 0 is identical to aug_random1_x1 (nested contrast)

selection.realizations: five random1 copies of D1 Validation (seeds augment_select); one targeted_lexical copy (first seed) is descriptive only
selection.objective: maximise the mean Macro F1 at 0.5 over the five random1 realizations
selection.guard: clean D1 Validation Macro F1 at 0.5 >= clean condition's value minus delta, where delta = one class-stratified bootstrap standard error of the clean condition's own validation Macro F1 (1,000 resamples, seed delta_se)
selection.tie_rule: candidates whose mean lies within the leader's realization SD are tied; ties prefer fewer copies, then lighter rate, then policy order random1 < random_rate < targeted_lexical, then list order
selection.fallback: if no candidate passes the guard, select the candidate with the highest clean validation Macro F1 and record guard_failed = true
selection.note: D1 Validation only. selected_config.json is written with frozen = true before any test split or D4 is opened; D1/D2/D3 Test and D4 are scored once afterwards.

evaluation.canonical_seed_note: augment_eval_canonical produces the handoff pairs; the canonical draw together with the augment_eval_extra draws (five random1 realizations) is summarised as mean and SD (ddof=1) in results/e5/evidence/eval_realizations.csv
evaluation.threshold_source: E5 provisional: tF1/t5 selected per model on clean D1 Validation with E1's rule; E6 owns the authoritative thresholds
evaluation.d4_note: D4 NotInject is benign-only and never perturbed: only FP/N, FPR and Wilson 95% intervals are reported, overall and by every slice column found among trigger_count and category; never F1, recall or AUROC.

bootstrap.resampling: paired, class-stratified (attack and benign rows resampled independently; D4 rows stratified by trigger_count when present); the same draw is applied to both models
bootstrap.primary_comparison: delta attack recall (augmented minus clean) under typo_random1 at the canonical evaluation seed on eligible attack rows of D1 Test at threshold 0.5
bootstrap.secondary: augmented minus clean at 0.5 and provisional tF1 for clean text on D1/D2/D3/D4 and for the canonical random1 and targeted_lexical copies of D1/D2/D3 test; provisional t5 for D1 clean text and D1 random1 text only; augmented minus dup_x1 for D1 (clean and both typo copies). All labelled secondary in bootstrap.csv

qa.nominal_rows: up to 12 strata x per_operator_per_stage + extra_real_word_rows = 140 rows before availability caps and de-duplication

criteria.qa_plausible_typo: the change looks like a slip a person could make on a keyboard
criteria.qa_word_recognizable: a reader still recognises the intended word
criteria.qa_meaning_unchanged: the sentence keeps its meaning and its label
criteria.qa_ok: 1 only if all three criteria hold

qa.failure_rule: a failed QA means fixing the generator and rerunning the whole experiment; never selective regeneration or re-selection

model_ids.note: stable regardless of which condition wins; the condition is recorded in selected_config.json and handoff/checkpoint_path.txt

provenance.note: SHA-256 of the manifest, dataset revisions and all dependency versions are recorded in results/e5/run_metadata.json at run time
